OlinkViz themed and journal palettes (named list)

Source: R/utils.R
olinkviz_palettes.Rd

Returns the OlinkViz themed palettes as a named list (or all built-in + journal palettes when `include_journal = TRUE`), or a single palette by name. Supported names include `"sunbird"`, `"redcap"`, `"jewel"`, `"scarlet"`, `"okabe_ito"`, `"nature"`, `"npg"`, `"aaas"` (`"science"`), `"nejm"`, `"lancet"`, `"jama"`, `"bmj"`, `"jco"`, and `"editorial"`.

Usage

olinkviz_palettes(name = NULL, include_journal = FALSE)

Arguments

name

Optional palette name. If `NULL` (default), palettes are returned as a named list.

include_journal

Logical; if `TRUE` and `name` is `NULL`, also include the journal-inspired and Okabe-Ito palettes (default `FALSE` for backward compatibility).

Value

A named list of palettes if `name` is `NULL`, otherwise a character vector of hex color codes.

See also

Other palettes: olinkviz_palette(), scale_colour_olinkviz()

Examples

names(olinkviz_palettes())
#> [1] "sunbird" "redcap"  "jewel"   "scarlet"
names(olinkviz_palettes(include_journal = TRUE))
#>  [1] "sunbird"   "redcap"    "jewel"     "scarlet"   "okabe_ito" "nature"   
#>  [7] "npg"       "aaas"      "science"   "nejm"      "lancet"    "jama"     
#> [13] "bmj"       "jco"       "editorial"
olinkviz_palettes("okabe_ito")
#> [1] "#0072B2" "#D55E00" "#009E73" "#E69F00" "#56B4E9" "#CC79A7" "#F0E442"
#> [8] "#000000"
olinkviz_palettes("npg")
#>  [1] "#E64B35" "#4DBBD5" "#00A087" "#3C5488" "#F39B7F" "#8491B4" "#91D1C2"
#>  [8] "#DC0000" "#7E6148" "#B09C85"
